title.en: Validate documents against the Humanitarian Profile schema

goal.en: The validate operation takes a schema name and a document. Validate the example offer, claim and manifest as humanitarian documents, then validate the offer as a recipe to see what errors look like.

note.en: The example offer against the humanitarian schema.
The manifest that lists the example documents.
The offer validated as a recipe: ok false and a list of errors, one per missing required recipe field plus one for the unknown properties.

outcome.en: You can validate documents from any language through the hub. Next: scenario 075 validates an impact summary.
